preregistration.C1: pass iff >=1 of 4 seed angles has retention >= 0.05 and circvar <= 0.6 after 50 darkness steps (Seelig & Jayaraman 2015)
preregistration.C2: pass iff sign(rot_left) != sign(rot_right) and both |rot| >= 0.05 deg/step, raw rates over 30 steps (Turner-Evans 2017; Green 2017)
preregistration.visual_aux: map only: survived iff both game runs retain >= 0.05 with circvar <= 0.6 after 50 visual steps
preregistration.amendment: C2/visual seed = highest-retention C1 angle (fixed rule), registered after the 2.0/0.3 smoke point measured the 22.5-deg seed dead (settled mass 0.0) and before the grid sweep; bands unchanged; original 22.5-deg arm recorded as c2_original_seed at every point
